title: Is sophistication a panacea? The learning capacity of random feature models for financial forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.27255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates the ability of random feature models to learn more complex patterns than the simple negative autocorrelation of financial returns. Theoretical insights highlight that the learning capacity of random features ridge regression is determined by the interplay between signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) level and regularization. We characterize the different learning regimes through the derivation of a particular threshold: the SNR frontier. Practically, our results permit to determine the minimum penalty level to be introduced into the estimation process in order to guard against a drop in the SNR during the implementation phase. We empirically apply this methodology to equity premium forecasting and use the output to build mean-variance efficient portfolios. The resulting portfolios yield substantial economic value over a portfolio construction scheme based on a short-term reversal strategy.

translated_title: 精巧复杂是万能药吗？随机特征模型在金融预测中的学习能力
translated_abstract: 本文研究了随机特征模型学习比金融收益的简单负自相关更复杂模式的能力。理论分析表明，随机特征岭回归的学习能力由信噪比（SNR）水平与正则化之间的相互作用所决定。我们通过推导一个特定的阈值——SNR边界——来刻画不同的学习机制。在实际应用中，我们的结果能够确定在估计过程中应引入的最小惩罚水平，以防止实施阶段SNR的下降。我们将该方法论实证应用于股票溢价预测，并利用其输出构建均值-方差有效投资组合。所得投资组合相较于基于短期反转策略的投资组合构建方案产生了可观的经济价值。
tldr: 本文提出“SNR边界”这一阈值概念来刻画随机特征岭回归的学习能力，确定了防止信噪比下降所需的最小正则化惩罚水平，并在股票溢价预测与均值-方差投资组合构建中实证验证了其显著的经济价值。
en_tdlr: The paper derives an "SNR frontier" threshold to characterize the learning capacity of random feature ridge regression—determined by the interplay between signal-to-noise ratio and regularization—to determine the minimum penalty level guarding against SNR drops, demonstrating substantial economic value in equity premium forecasting and mean-variance portfolio construction.
